svg.aria-label: Separate FPGA V41 and LDO V5 complete schematics, both mating connector pairs retained
svg.title: Separate FPGA V41 + LDO V5 — complete one-page comparison
svg.desc: Read-only native schematic exports placed at the same unscaled source-geometry offsets used by Combined V6. Both J1/J2 mating pairs remain. This SVG composition does not merge nets or alter native CAD.
svg.text: Complete source schematics · Both FPGA-to-LDO mating connector pairs retained
